target.title: fix(usage): preserve provider-billed zero totals
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Follow-up to #97047 after the direct DeepSeek V4 zero-cost regression was fixed on `main`.

The remaining accounting gap is that `usage.cost.total: 0` is ambiguous in persisted transcripts:

- it can be a fabricated placeholder zero from a transport/catalog path, which should be recomputed or treated as missing when pricing is known/unknown; or
- it can be an authoritative provider-billed total from a provider billing endpoint, including a legitimate free/zero-cost route.

OpenRouter is the concrete provider-billed case: its generation metadata endpoint returns `total_cost`, and that value is the provider's billing total. When `total_cost` is `0`, core usage aggregation should preserve it only when the transcript carries explicit provenance proving that the zero came from provider billing.

## Why This Change Was Made

The earlier follow-up approach was rejected because it guessed from provider/model ids and treated every known-priced all-zero row as authoritative. This version follows the maintainer guidance instead:

- no DeepSeek/OpenRouter model ids are hard-coded into core usage accounting;
- OpenRouter, as the provider owner, marks generation-metadata totals as provider-billed;
- core aggregation uses a generic provenance signal rather than provider-specific policy;
- rows without provenance keep the current `main` behavior, so suspicious known-priced zero totals still get recomputed.

## What Changed

- Add `usage.cost.totalOrigin?: "provider-billed" | "estimated"` to the usage/cost type contract.
- When OpenRouter generation metadata lookup succeeds, set:
  - `usage.cost.total = data.total_cost`
  - `usage.cost.totalOrigin = "provider-billed"`
- Teach session usage-cost scanning to preserve recorded zero totals when `totalOrigin` is `provider-billed`.
- Keep the existing protection for provider-reconciled zero totals with nonzero cost components.
- Keep existing recomputation/missing-cost behavior for unproven all-zero known-priced/unknown-priced rows.
- Bump the durable usage-cost cache version from 6 to 7 because recognized cost-total provenance changes cached total semantics.

## Evidence

Regression coverage added/updated:

- `extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`
  - nonzero OpenRouter generation metadata cost is marked `provider-billed`
  - zero OpenRouter generation metadata cost is marked `provider-billed`
  - failed/oversized generation metadata lookup keeps the streamed estimate and does not set provider-billed provenance
- `src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts`
  - provider-billed all-zero cost total with known pricing remains zero in summary, durable cache, and session logs
  - known-priced transcript rows without provider-billed provenance still recompute from catalog pricing
  - version-6 durable cache entries are stale under the new provenance-aware semantics

Local targeted validation on the pushed head:

- `git diff --check -- src/agents/usage.ts packages/llm-core/src/types.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.types.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts extensions/openrouter/stream.ts extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`
- `CI=1 NO_COLOR=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`
  - `src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts`: 66 passed
  - `extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`: 46 passed

## Relationship to Closed PRs

This supersedes the closed #97134 and #101163 follow-up attempts. The closed PRs tried to resolve the conflict by scoping behavior from core. This PR instead adds the explicit provenance contract requested in review.

## Conflict Resolution

The branch is based on current `openclaw/openclaw@3accc99b43` and has no merge conflict with `main`.

## Risk

Low-to-moderate behavior risk, limited to cost accounting for transcript rows with `usage.cost.total: 0`.

Expected behavior after this change:

- Provider-billed zero total with explicit `totalOrigin: "provider-billed"`: preserved as authoritative zero.
- Known-priced placeholder zero without provenance: recomputed from catalog pricing.
- Unknown/all-zero pricing with nonzero tokens and no provenance: still reported as missing cost.
- Positive recorded provider costs: preserved by existing behavior.

No workflow, dependency, lockfile, secret, or release artifact changes.
